candidates.change_summary: Replace the require guard with a no-op boolean expression, removing the non-empty _tos check.
Change the computed function selector to a different 4-byte value.
Initialize the loop counter to 1 instead of 0, skipping the first target.
Invert the loop condition so iteration runs only when the length is zero or negative, typically causing no external calls.
Remove the loop counter increment, causing an infinite loop if the loop body is entered.
Change the first argument passed to the external call from the provided from address to the caller's own address.
Swap the recipient argument to always pass the fixed caddress instead of the loop target.
Remove the revert on failed external call so failures are ignored.
Replace the external call with a direct expression statement, removing the call entirely.
Return false instead of true after a successful loop.
